steps.name: extract_entities
steps.prompt: Extract all named entities from this text including: people, organizations, locations, dates, and monetary amounts. List each type separately.

steps.name: summarize
steps.prompt: Provide a concise summary of this document in 2-3 paragraphs. Focus on the main points and key information.

steps.name: classify
steps.prompt: Classify this document. Determine: 1) Document type (letter, report, legal document, etc.), 2) Primary topic or subject matter, 3) Time period if mentioned, 4) Formality level (formal/informal)
